summary: Silicom Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing its participation in the 21st Annual Needham Technology, Media, Consumer Conference on May 12, 2026, with a formal presentation and one-on-one meetings. This is a routine investor relations activity, not a special situation event. No deal terms, activist activity, strategic review, or transactional catalyst is present. The filing merely complies with foreign private issuer reporting obligations. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, spin-off, capital return, tender offer, restructuring, or management change. As a routine conference participation notice, the appropriate classification is None.
